scope: Twenty-five residual noncanonical forms in the base-paper različny adjective family.
choice: Repair 19 genitive-plural forms to različnyh, three non-masculine-animate nominative-plural forms to različne, and three feminine oblique forms to različnoj.
motivation: The official hard-stem adjective must agree in case, number and gender; every source site was sentence-adjudicated.
alternatives_rejected: Leaving South-shaped -ih or malformed -oh preserves a mixed declension.
Blindly mapping every form to one suffix would corrupt nominative-plural and feminine-oblique contexts.

evidence.semantic_review: All 25 sites were checked against their noun heads; no comments, control names, foreign arguments or non-adjectival različnost forms are included.

validation.postcondition: All four noncanonical source forms zero and target totals exact.
